marker_source.format: Model loading took %s GiB memory and %.6f seconds
marker_source.semantics: Before get_model_loader to after model_loader.load_model and optional LoRA/drafter/aux setup; excludes subsequent load-evidence capture and communication-buffer setup. Not an isolated GLM weight-ingestion span.

test.data_scope: Tiny temporary synthetic logs/manifest only; euid mocked to exercise consumer; never reads actual private logs.

contract: Root check before manifest or output access
Finite manifest SHA and per-qualification SHA; exactly38 distinct original-qualified runs; no supplement/history
Top-level stdout/stderr glob only, no recursion or model files
O_NOFOLLOW/nonregular rejection; per-file8MiB and cumulative log128MiB; dev/ino/size/mtime stable before/after/path
O_EXCL0600 output, no overwrite; raw logs and arbitrary environment lines not exported
Only numeric model-loading markers and source SHA/bytes/mtime; import marker limited known module origins and package versions
Absent logs/marker null, malformed import marker explicit; any source/hash/identity/bounds error fails instead of pretending collection success
not_performed: Actual root collection or historical log read
limits: Read syscall duration cooperative/kernel boundedness not claimed; execute under existing outer scope if desired.
Numeric logs can repeat or be forwarded; collector does not infer TP-rank reduction or assert GLM-C equivalence.
Actual historical markers/identity coverage unknown until root executes after review.
delta_from_v1: Each file includes exact source_path along with SHA/bytes/mtime.
Each run distinguishes NO_LOG_FILES / NO_MATCH / OBSERVED.
Each numeric marker rank/pid explicitly null; duration list is observations, never single C or TP reduction.
O_EXCL output check after manifest reads remains intentional; no pre-read access guarantee claimed.
